BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the reduction in force of tenured orprobationary community college faculty members; and repealing RCW28B.50.873.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 28B.50.873 (Reduction in force oftenured or probationary faculty members due to financial emergencyConditionsProcedureRights) and 1991 c 238 s 72, 1990 c 33 s 559,1989 c 175 s 81, & 1981 2nd ex.s. c 13 s 1 are each repealed.
